# Wisdom of Solomon Chapter 10 — The EMET Bible (Literal)
**Translator:** EMET | **Source:** Codex Vaticanus, Wisdom 10 | **Source Image:** source-texts/greek-DC/WIS_010_page_001.jpg

---

**10:1** She guarded the first-formed father of the world, who was created alone, and she rescued him from his own transgression,

**10:2** and gave him strength to rule over all-things.

**10:3** But when an unrighteous man departed from her in his anger, he perished himself in the rage of brother-murder.

**10:4** When on his account the earth was flooded, Wisdom again rescued [it], steering the righteous man through paltry wood.

**10:5** She also, when the nations in their evil-agreement were being-confounded, recognized the righteous man and kept him blameless before God, and kept him strong in the face-of compassion for [his] child.

**10:6** A righteous man — when the ungodly were perishing, she rescued him, fleeing from a fire descending upon the Pentapolis.

**10:7** Of whose wickedness even yet there stands as witness a smoking desolation, plants producing-fruit that does-not ripen at-the appointed-time, and a salt-standing-pillar, a monument of an unbelieving soul.

**10:8** For, having passed-by Wisdom, not only were they harmed in this: that they were-ignorant of what is good, but also they left behind for life a monument of [their] folly, so-that in what they-stumbled, they could-not be unnoticed.

**10:9** But Wisdom rescued from sufferings the ones who-served her.

**10:10** She guided a righteous man in straight paths, who was-fleeing from a brother's wrath; she showed him the kingdom of God and gave him knowledge of holy-things; she prospered him in his labors and multiplied the fruit of his labors.

**10:11** When in-their-greediness those who-were-oppressing him, she stood-by and made him rich.

**10:12** She guarded him from enemies and from those-lying-in-wait she kept-him-safe, and a hard contest she adjudged for him, so-that he-might-know that godliness is mightier than all-things.

**10:13** She did-not abandon a righteous man when he was-sold, but from sin she rescued him;

**10:14** she went-down with him into a pit, and in bonds she did-not leave him, until she brought him the scepter of a kingdom and authority over those-who-were-lording-it-over him, and she showed as-false those who-had-spoken-ill-of him, and gave him eternal glory.

**10:15** She rescued a holy people and a blameless seed from a nation of oppressors.

**10:16** She entered into the soul of a servant of the Lord and withstood fearsome kings with wonders and signs.

**10:17** She gave to-the holy men the reward of their labors; she led them on a marvelous road and became to-them a shelter by day and a flame of stars by night.

**10:18** She brought them through the Red Sea and led them through great water.

**10:19** But their enemies she swallowed-up, and from the depth of the abyss she spewed them out.

**10:20** Therefore the righteous plundered the ungodly and they hymned, O Lord, your holy name and praised with-one-accord your hand that-had-fought-for-them;

**10:21** because Wisdom opened the mouths of those-who-were-mute and made the tongues of infants speak clearly.
